text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x is loaned to y.
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
Premises:
Born(ailton, 1995) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ LoanedTo(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Brazilian(ailton) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlaysFor(x, nautico) ∧ Brazilian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
